questions.question: Jesus sent seventy-two followers ahead of Him to towns one at a time, each one on his own. True or false?
Jesus told the seventy-two the harvest was plentiful but the workers were few. What did He tell them to do?

answers.text: Ask the Lord of the harvest to send out workers
Hire more workers from the towns nearby
Let the field rest until next season

questions.question: When the seventy-two returned to Jesus with joy, what did they tell Him?

answers.text: Even the demons submitted to them in His name
The dead were raised in every town
Fire fell from heaven at their word

questions.question: Jesus told the seventy-two not to rejoice that spirits obeyed them. What did He say they should rejoice about instead?

answers.text: That their names are written in heaven
That every town will remember them
That they will see greater miracles
